models_evaluated: commercial deep-learning auto-contouring software for gynecological brachytherapy

links.outcome: Interobserver agreement and contouring time, AI-assisted versus manual contouring by radiation oncologists
links.effect: AI-assisted interobserver agreement was better than manual for all organs and metrics; median contouring time 14.8 vs 6.9 minutes/patient (p < 0.001).
links.quote: AI-assisted interobserver agreement was better than manual interobserver agreement for all organs and metrics.

links.effect: DSC was 0.92 bladder, 0.79 rectum, 0.62 sigmoid, and 0.66 bowel.
links.quote: Between clinical and AI contours, DSC was 0.92, 0.79, 0.62, 0.66, for bladder, rectum, sigmoid, and bowel, respectively.

links.effect: Median time was 14.8 minutes/patient manually versus 6.9 minutes/patient AI-assisted (p < 0.001).
links.quote: The median time to contour all organs for manual and AI-assisted approaches was 14.8 and 6.9 minutes/patient (p < 0.001), respectively.

unlisted_practices: Clinician review and editing of AI-generated contours
